title: Special Activation Precincts
notes: Parkes and Wagga target freight/logistics, advanced manufacturing, agribusiness, renewable energy and recycling; planning complete and delivery underway.

title: Parkes Special Activation Precinct
notes: Serviced inland-port precinct at junction of Inland Rail and Trans-Australian railway; government states access to 80% of Australian population within 12 hours by road/rail.

title: Parkes private investment announcement
notes: Three companies planning $65m private investment; proposals not yet operating assets.

title: Wagga Wagga Special Activation Precinct
notes: Includes established Bomen industrial estate and new RiFL intermodal facility; serviced industrial lots available.

title: Western Sydney Aerotropolis investment update
notes: Private projects at various stages reported at $21.6b in Apr 2026; freight/logistics, advanced manufacturing, distribution and data centres prominent; >$28b public enabling cited.

title: Aldi automated distribution centre approval
notes: $1b approved automated distribution centre beside Western Sydney Airport; expected 585 permanent jobs and heavy automation.

title: Major projects cementing Aerotropolis and Bradfield
notes: Second Bradfield building under construction; semiconductor advanced packaging facility plus approved $1b industrial estate.

title: Strong FY25 trade through Port of Brisbane
notes: FY25: 1.62m TEU; 34.9 Mt trade; $73.5b international cargo; ~200ha Future Port Expansion area.

title: Port of Brisbane Vision 2060
notes: Projects ~5m+ TEU annually by 2060 and frames dedicated freight rail as major long-run supply-chain infrastructure.

title: Port Botany capabilities
notes: Current 2.8m TEU scale, >7m TEU capacity, all three container terminals have on-dock rail, direct links to Sydney intermodal network.

title: Port Kembla trade and future container role
notes: Future NSW container terminal has concept approval; current role includes vehicles, bulk and project cargo.

title: NSW Ports rail strategy and investment
coverage: Port Botany / Port Kembla / Sydney intermodal network
notes: Long-term Port Botany rail target 3m TEU/year; staged on-dock rail investment and metropolitan intermodal links.

title: Port of Newcastle capability
notes: States capacity for 10,000 ship movements and >200 Mt cargo annually, channel operating ~50% capacity and significant port land available.

title: Port of Melbourne FY25 trade data
notes: FY25 record 3.39m TEU and $154b trade value; CY2025 later reached 3.5m TEU.

title: Port of Melbourne 2055 Port Development Strategy
notes: Webb Dock North planned container capacity, former market site land, completed Port Rail Transformation Project and future Webb Dock freight-link planning.

title: GeelongPort current trade and facilities
notes: 13.6m+ tonnes cargo; $10.2b+ trade; 1,060 vessel visits; 15 berths across two precincts.

title: Port of Geelong 2024 Port Development Strategy
notes: Plans port capacity, transport corridors and land needs around regional catchments and future trade growth.

title: Moorebank Intermodal Precinct terminals
notes: Interstate terminal opened 2024; current configuration 250k TEU/year, expandable to 500k TEU/year; IMEX terminal links to Port Botany and interstate network.

title: Enfield Intermodal Logistics Centre
notes: 60ha logistics centre 18km from Port Botany on dedicated freight rail; NSW Ports investing $250m and states significant spare container-handling capacity.

title: Cooks River Intermodal Terminal
notes: Direct daily Port Botany rail shuttles; multiple sidings for regional trains; major empty-container storage role.
